newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli troops kill Palestinian in West Bank.
newsitem.headline: Israeli troops kill Palestinian in West Bank.

text.p: Israeli troops shot and killed one Palestinian and wounded two others on Sunday in a village just west of Hebron in the West Bank, Palestinian sources and hospital officials said.
The Palestinian sources said an Israeli patrol entered Haras village and opened fire when Palestinians threw stones killing one man and wounding two.
Hospital officials in Hebron identified the dead man as Issam Akabneh, 18.
The Israeli army said it was checking the report.
The incident came as Israeli-Palestinian peacemaking remained in deep crisis over Israel's beginning a new Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem in March.
For weeks after groundbreaking for the 6,500-unit settlement Palestinians throwing stones battled Israeli troops in the West Bank. The unrest had abated somewhat in the last week.
Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on Sunday described as "a barbaric, shameful act" the stabbing to death of two Israeli women whose bodies were found in the West Bank on Friday.
Arafat said Israeli and Palestinian officers met to discuss the issue. Israeli police said they were investigating whether the killers were Palestinian guerrillas.
